consensus_example.npz.description: Fig S6, breast largest niche (seed 0): three random tiles' gene dendrograms (linkage, leaves), the consensus linkage (mean cophenetic matrix; leaf order == layout), blocks, clade flag and two marker genes per block, mean correlation and gene names in niche order

dyadic_example.npz.description: Fig S7, breast largest niche, its most co-varying block of 20-32 genes (seed 0 Spindle-Partial): every aligned dyadic interval (s, j, K_I), an illustrative gene set's pieces and node counts, every tile's node in every piece, the block's mean correlation and gene names

example.npz.description: breast example: correlation matrix (float32) of the index tile whose median between-block |r| is the median of the largest niche, in niche order; block runs, niche, tile, genes

hist.csv.description: |r| histogram (bin_lo, bin_hi, count) of the within-block and between-block gene pairs of every index tile, per dataset; seed-0 layout, shrunk covariances in niche order

niche_example.npz.description: breast: the largest niche's mean correlation matrix (float32) in its gene order, block runs, niche, tiles

niche_hist.csv.description: |r| histogram (bins of 0.001) over each niche's mean correlation matrix, pooled over the niches: full matrix (every off-diagonal pair) and blocks (pairs inside a block); seed-0 layout

summary.csv.description: per dataset and part (within / between): pairs, |r| quantiles q50 / q90 / q99 (upper bin edge, bins of 0.001) and the fraction of pairs with |r| > 0.1 and > 0.3

tile_means.csv.description: one row per index tile (seed-0 layout): niche, mean |r| over its within-block and between-block gene pairs (pairs with a gene without counts in the tile left out), pair counts
